note: One manifest, checked by .github/scripts/testing-layers.mjs: every test file in the repository belongs to a suite row, and every workflow in .github/workflows/ has a row. The tables in docs/testing-layers.md are generated from this file, so the two cannot drift (#749).

L1.name: commit
L1.trigger: Push to a branch, a pull request, and every queue entry, through `.github/workflows/test.yml`.
L1.guarantee: The cheapest layer that can catch a defect: it must be deterministic and hermetic — no network, no model, no wall-clock or calendar dependence, no ordering between files.
L1.mustNot: Reach the network, call a model, read the clock, or depend on a machine's home directory.
L1.budget: The whole layer under 10 minutes on a cold runner. A suite that cannot fit is either split or moved up, not added.
L1.command: node .github/scripts/testing-layers.mjs --check && npm --prefix core test && npm --prefix plugins/social test && npm --prefix plugins/tree test && npm --prefix plugins/timeline test && node --test ".github/scripts/*.test.mjs" && npm run test:interop

L2.name: merge
L2.trigger: Every merge into `main`, through the merge queue: `test.yml` on the queue entry plus `merge-gate.yml` on that entry.
L2.guarantee: Everything a merge must not break: every L1 suite, the ds-bot pin and patch set, the packaged plugin entry points, the strict typecheck of the plugin API, well-formed changelog fragments, the workflow lint, and the verdict/`hold` judgement at the exact commit being merged.
L2.mustNot: Be bypassed. `main` requires these checks; a ref push that never built a queue entry cannot land.
L2.budget: The checkout-to-green time of `test.yml` plus `merge-gate` on one queue entry; the queue's own limit applies.

L3.name: self-test
L3.trigger: The product self-test routine (09:00 and 21:00 Asia/Shanghai) and `live-e2e.yml` on `main` daily; a person drives the former.
L3.guarantee: What a user meets: two real homes, a real Bot Social, a real model, and a person watching. It is not deterministic, so it produces issues with reproduction steps instead of failing a merge.
L3.mustNot: Gate a merge, or be the only copy of a case that can be reproduced offline: an L3 case that turns out deterministic moves down to L1 and leaves a pointer.
L3.budget: A full self-test pass is minutes of wall-clock time with a real model; a live-e2e run is the same on `main`.
L3.command: node dev/live-e2e/run.mjs <bench> <port> --model <id> --harness <dsh checkout> --tap <bench>/tap.jsonl --tz Asia/Shanghai  # needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; live-e2e.yml is the automated form

suites.reason: Generated copies of the files the patches carry. They are compared against `core/` by `node scripts/ds-bot-patches.mjs check` (L2) and never run on their own; the code under test is the copy in `core/`.
The pristine upstream checkout at the pinned version. FlyBot never edits or runs it directly — `core/` is `ds-bot/` plus the patches, and the `core` suite runs the patched copies.

Offline unit tests for the live end-to-end harness (a fake adapter, no model). They run in the root `npm run verify` only; no CI gate runs them today. Moving them into L1 is a separate change, and the layer that does drive a real model is `live-e2e.yml`, whose row is below.

workflows.role: Runs every L1 suite, the packaging and patch-pin checks, the strict typecheck, the changelog check and the workflow lint on `push`, `pull_request` and `merge_group`, and aggregates them as `tests-ok`, which `main` requires.
Re-reads `hold` and the newest conclusion at the entry's head, and fails the queue entry when either refuses it.
Builds the container image and starts it, so a packaging change cannot merge without the image proving it starts.
Drives the real end-to-end suite with a real model against `main`; it is the automation behind the self-test layer, and it never gates a merge.

workflows.reason: Validates and posts the conclusion on a pull request. It gates nothing by itself: `merge-gate` re-judges the entry at merge time.
Reports the computed risk tier on every pull request. Nothing reads it to block or merge; the tier that decides is recomputed by `merge-gate`.
The label poll: sets `agent-pr` and `risk:T*`, demotes a stale claim. It runs no tests and gates nothing.
A daily read-only audit that fails on a merge newer than its last green run. Advisory: it is not a required check of `main`.
Scheduled cleanup of status labels on closed issues and pull requests (#738). A workflow-only layer with no test file of its own, and it gates nothing.

workflows.runs: daily 00:00 Asia/Shanghai, Sunday 01:00 compat matrix, and workflow_dispatch
workflows.reason: The compatibility matrix (other OS, Node and DSH versions) on a schedule. It widens coverage but is not a gate, and its cases are not part of L1 or L2.
The mechanical release: preflight, release PR, tag. It runs no tests of its own.
Applies the `pass` label to a pull request whose conclusion was a PASS, and backfills merged ones (#739). A workflow-only layer with no test file of its own, and it gates nothing.
